arrival.text: THE ELDERWork's on the board. Men for hire wait at the posts, and the bar has drink.

ask.name: EL GUERO SALAS, THE YARD BOSS
ask.said: Four hundred tyres came in for the fair and there is room for two hundred, and the co-op wants eighty. Haul them over, do not sell any on the way, and 45 batteries are yours.

client.name: EL GUERO SALAS, THE YARD BOSS
client.text: Haul eighty tyres to the co-opEL GUERO SALAS, THE YARD BOSS 45 batteries · 2 H
